title: Builder candidate (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/candidate.json, Stage 3 artifact)
description: The state of /work when Tier 0 gave ok, turned into a commit on the run's base (message "a2dlc <builder> <run_id>", also in refs/a2dlc/run/<slice>/<builder>). What counts is /work, not what the Builder said. Stage 4 judges this commit instead of the user's working tree. The top-level fields are those of the first candidate (builder_primary if it converged). With track N=2 (route.json and builder_orthogonal in roles.json) both builders run, each in its own /work; candidates lists those that converged and dropped those that did not, with their reason; with two candidates Stage 4 judges each one with the other as peer and chooses (selection.json).

candidates.description: Only with N=2: the candidates that converged, in the order they ran (primary, orthogonal).

dropped.description: Only with N=2: builders that left no candidate (Tier 0 does not converge, refused, changed nothing, touched .a2dlc/ (CB-04) or the tool failed). They are not omitted.

headers_missing.description: Only the first candidate (as unchecked): changed source files without an @a2dlc:slice_id line (§6.3). The stage does not fail; the engine's Tier 0 lint decides whether the absence is an error. Absent or [] if all of them declare it.

tree_hash.description: Git tree of the commit, without the gate outputs (gitx.Excluded).

iterations.description: Rounds builder → tier0 until ok (≤ max_inner_iterations).

unchecked.description: What Tier 0 did not review: changed files without an engine or whose engine does not do tier0, and probes without an engine (probe:<probe_id>). Nothing is omitted: it stays here and in the stage's reason.

headers_missing.description: Changed source files without any @a2dlc:slice_id line (§6.3). The stage does not fail: the engine's Tier 0 lint decides whether the absence is an error (config.tier0.require_header). Absent or [] if all of them declare it.

tier0_reviewed.description: Whether Tier 0 ran anything on the candidate (an engine reviewed a file or a probe). a2dlc run does not leave a candidate with false: a Tier 0 that ran nothing escalates the stage ("Tier 0 did not run anything: …"). Absent in candidates prior to this field.

lemmas.description: Lemma verdicts of this candidate (Critical slices). no_pair: the base has no lemma of the same name to compare with.

dependency_changes.description: Dependencies this candidate added or changed in its manifests, each checked against the allowlist file (config.supply_chain).
